availability_audit: Every member's pool-48 entry was checked for gate and source map. Metagross, Excadrill, Incineroar, Amoonguss and Togekiss are evolution-gated lines whose windows (24-48) all open at or before this battle; Salamence is wild in Meteor Falls B1F back room, which the fresh run reaches before the Fortree stretch. No AshenWoods/gate-48 legendary-sign species and no legendaries at all are used. For the Route 103 Surf-backtrack trio the battle is reached AFTER Norman, so the player legitimately holds the full cap-48 inventory; nothing here is sourced from a map later than Route 115-119. Free Center held-item catalogue supplies the ordinary items; Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly.
plan: The dossier's crack line is weather replacement, Taunt, Grass/Fairy pressure and speed reversal; this party brings the Grass half and the speed answer honestly rather than bringing an automatic weather setter to switch the encounter off. Rillaboom's Grassy Glide is priority, so Swift Swim Seismitoad's rain Speed does not matter, and Grass is 4x into Seismitoad and 2x into a rain-form Castform. Mega Metagross is immune to Goodra's Sludge Bomb (Steel), halves Thunder, Hurricane and Draco Meteor, and Ice Punch is 4x into Noivern. Togekiss is the Fairy body that is outright immune to Draco Meteor and to Earth Power. Deliberate choice: Castform is NOT denied its Rain Dance on turn 1, so the authored weather plan can be observed executing.
